correctness.rationale: The exact two-cube convex hull gives W_O=max(2U,2V,U+V+T) and W_C=2max(U,V), T=|sum_j b v_j|. Normalizing W_O=2 gives feasible polytope with exactly six vertices; bounding Euclidean dual norm by Q(U,V,T)=U²/a²+(V²+T²)/(2b²), a strictly convex quadratic, reduces maximum to two vertices (1,1,0) and (0,1,1). Equality requires one lower active coordinate and one positive/negative upper pair, or one upper coordinate; tie at a=√2b includes both and no continuum. Vertex-to-vertex squared distances give the two separate diameter branches and exact equality pair classes. Exact finite profile checks confirm support and distance identities, not infinite classification.
